rules.description: At least 50 TCP packets for statistics (flows, retransmissions).
Report retransmission frames. Zero is valid for a delay-only profile; loss experiments must explain observed retransmissions separately.

manual_checks: Record the selected delay/loss profile and compare before/after timing or loss metrics. Random loss does not guarantee a retransmission in a finite capture.
R1 R2 R3: Record the profile and before/after timing statistics. A delay-only run may have zero retransmissions.
